lead_raw_text:
The structure of TmGeSb is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a cell formula Tm4Ge4Sb4 and 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Ge centers 10 neighbors (4 Ge, 3 Sb, 3 Tm), Sb centers 9 neighbors (4 Ge, 3 Sb, 2 Tm), and Tm centers 14 neighbors (6 Ge, 4 Sb, 4 Tm). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Ge and Sb polyhedra, corner-sharing between Ge and Tm polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing between Tm polyhedra.
